subject: Formalizing Sofia's transition: shadow → permanent manager (onboarding & review plan)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Sam Kerr <sam.kerr@greenline.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 08:13:00 -0800
Subject: Formalizing Sofia's transition: shadow → permanent manager (onboarding & review plan)

Team,

Sofia has completed the 6-week shadow period running the Platform Integrations group and I’d like to move forward with making the role permanent. Attached is a short transition packet and a one-page performance summary for Q3. Key asks:

- Approve promotion to Manager (level M2) with a start date of 2026-11-16.
- Confirm the 90-day objective plan and check-in cadence below.
- Monica: please initiate the promotion packet and banding review; we’ll need compensation sign-off.
- Vivek: I’m hoping you can confirm that the org reporting and admin accesses are ready the week prior.

Proposed 90-day plan (high level):
1) 0-30 days: transition of people leads, ownership of weekly roadmap, weekly 1:1s established.
2) 30-60 days: measurable delivery targets for the Integrations backlog (2 OKRs).
3) 60-90 days: calibration meeting with Laura & Rishi; recommendation to convert permanent status.

Attachments: [sofia_transition_plan_v1.docx], [performance-summary-Q3-2026.pdf]

If there are blocking items (comp, background, references), flag them here and we’ll pause. Sam from Greenline — thanks for agreeing to be a quick reference.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Formalizing Sofia's transition: shadow → permanent manager (onboarding & review plan)

Thanks Naomi — congrats to Sofia. A few HR checklist items we need before we can finalize: 

1) Compensation banding: please confirm target OTE adjustment (if any). If we move to M2 with a band increase, Finance will need an impact memo.
2) Employment verification & reference: Sam’s confirmation is helpful; I will run a quick reference call on Monday.
3) Background check: Sofia’s last check with us was 2022; per policy we need a refresh.
4) Promotion documentation: please upload the signed manager expectations doc to the PeopleOps SharePoint (link preferred).

Deliverables I’ll take on: I’ll open the internal promotion packet, add the compensation fields, and request a DocuSign packet for Sofia. Expect a first draft of the packet and a DocuSign link by 2026-11-09 EOD. 

Quick Q for Vivek: do any of Sofia’s direct reports require reclassification (IC -> Senior IC or Lead) as part of this move? That affects org chart updates.

—Monica
Monica Patel, Senior People Partner

Subject: Re: Formalizing Sofia's transition: shadow → permanent manager (onboarding & review plan)

Naomi / Monica — I fully support. Notes from my side: 

- Performance highlights: repeatedly led post-mortem remediation (three incidents) and rebuilt the partner onboarding checklist; cross-functional feedback has been overwhelmingly positive. See bullets in the attached performance summary.
- Org adjustments: I recommend moving Priya Natarajan to report directly to Sofia effective 2026-11-16; Priya has been acting as lead on onboarding and is a natural match.
- Access: Platform admin and weekly reporting dashboards should be provisioned by 2026-11-13; IT has been looped.
- Trial metrics (suggested): reduce onboarding time by 25% within 60 days; maintain <2% partner integration failures month-over-month.

I don’t see any blockers from my side. Monica — happy to hop on a 15-min call to help with the promo packet if helpful.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Engineering

Subject: Re: Formalizing Sofia's transition: shadow → permanent manager (onboarding & review plan)

Appreciate the packet and recommendation. A couple of adjustments before final sign-off: 

- I prefer we phrase this as a 90-day confirmation period (not a probation) with clear go/no-go criteria attached to the two OKRs. HR should capture the objective metrics in the packet.
- Finance needs the comp delta (if any). Rishi — can you confirm budget availability for a band change?
- Please add a mid-point 45-day calibration with me and Naomi in addition to the 90-day review.

Assuming those items are resolved I’m happy to sign off and recommend we convert to permanent after the 90-day review.

Laura Bennett

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps (finalizing today):

- Agreement: move forward with start date 2026-11-16 and a 90-day confirmation period with a 45-day mid-point calibration (Laura + Naomi).
- Monica: please publish the promotion packet and DocuSign by EOD; include the trial metrics (onboarding time reduction & failure rate) and a checkbox for Finance band approval.
- Rishi: please confirm budget by 2026-11-10 12:00 PT. If there’s no band increase, we will still effect the title change on 11/16.
- Vivek: proceed with org-change for Priya to report to Sofia on 11/16; notify the team after comp/HR sign-off.
- Sam: appreciate availability for a 5–10 minute reference if HR needs it.
